title: THE STASH DOLL: LONG NAMES WRAP IN A SLOT, THE LIST FADES AT ITS EDGE
why: seen on the pictures of v37.45: a rare breacher plate was cut off in its slot, outfit names lost the bottom of their letters, worse sat under the contrast floor on the tip panel, the critic found the last list row cut mid word and an amber scroll thumb
now: a long piece name wraps to two lines in its slot, outfit names show whole, the tip panel is darker so worse reads, the list fades out at its bottom edge and its scroll thumb is the panel line colour

edits.replacement:
// v37.xx (cw-m3doll3), critic P1: the last row was cut mid word by the list edge, so the list fades out over its last 24px; a row the highlight lands on stops clear of the fade. Critic P2: the thumb is the panel line colour, not amber.
